question_ru: Все ли три машины перечислены ровно как PromptToTaskMachine, OrchestrationReasoningMachine, SkillSelectionMachine?
expected_result: PASS only if no machine is missing and no extra machine is added.

question_ru: Совпадают ли current checkpoint path, manifest path, locator ref и sha256 с P48/models/index/manifests?
expected_result: PASS only if all current asset candidates match exact paths and hashes.

question_ru: Остаются ли target refs INACTIVE/NONE и запрещает ли досье silent overwrite текущего checkpoint?
expected_result: PASS only if target requires a future new staged checkpoint path and fresh approval.

question_ru: Описан ли rollback как candidate-only до будущего выбора exact machine + operation?
expected_result: PASS only if rollback refs are exact current repo checkpoint candidates and not active rollback instructions.

question_ru: Разрешена ли неоднозначность OrchestrationReasoning без мутации: locator-current vs alternate historical candidate?
expected_result: PASS only if orchestration-reasoning-v1-checkpoint.json is locator-current and checkpoint.json is alternate historical/evidence-only unless future approval chooses it.

question_ru: Для P27/P31/P36/P41/P45/P47 указан ли текущий статус и common_training_allowed_now=false?
expected_result: PASS only if every named phase remains not authorized for common training and names required approval/license/redaction/source-family review.

question_ru: Содержит ли approval packet template конкретные известные пути/хэши и оставляет placeholders только для свежего approval/future staged target/source-license artifact?
expected_result: PASS only if known P48/P49 fields are concrete and unknown future approval fields remain placeholders.

question_ru: Сработал ли forbidden claim firewall: нет semantic quality, readiness, training/eval/checkpoint mutation/host runtime claims?
expected_result: PASS only if dossier explicitly denies those claims and verification confirms no forbidden action was run.
